takes place in the middle of a futuristic city. The city contains multiple tall buildings, which have neon windows, beams coming out of their roofs, text moving on them and video panels with neon screens. The city has multiple roads and pathways for cars and civilians. The roads are black with either yellow or red lines going through them. The yellow lines are lines that enemies follow, with red lines being paths cut off from the enemies. These roads also have multiple pedestrian crossing. On the pathways, there are multiple video panels and potted plants, alongside a few red blockades preventing access to the main playable area.

The path starts at the danger tunnel and ends at the escape tunnel. It takes multiple turns, avoiding multiple of the buildings present on this map.

, there were a lot of futuristic buildings and skyscrapers around the map, as well as some grass pots that could have cliff towers placed on them. It was heavily urbanized, with various neon blue lampposts and benches also being dotted around the map. The map was surrounded by water on one side and mountainous terrain on the other side.

The path was a street, with some pedestrian crossings, that began and ended at two caves in the mountain. The path twisted and turned a fair bit around skyscrapers, which made it suitable to place ground towers just about anywhere along the path.
was exactly identical to the second version, except with terrain water surrounding the island.

had futuristic buildings and a skyscraper, as well as some grassy mounds to place cliff towers on. The map was on an island, completely surrounded by water. It was not too heavily urbanized, as the grass of the island was visible throughout the island.

The black stone path began at a cave and ended at the entrance of a museum-like building. The path twisted and turned a fair bit around buildings.

had futuristic office buildings which reinforced the idea of the future. It also had grassy mounds to place cliff towers on. The map was an island completely surrounded by water. It was not too heavily urbanized, as the grass of the island was visible throughout the island.
